D: Four scientists set up shop above a Chinese restaurant and start catching ghosts across Manhattan.
P: Serve the snacks when the wonton soup arrives with hardly any wontons.
S: Pork and prawn wontons in ginger chicken broth with bok choy
Pork and prawn wontons folded and simmered in chicken stock with ginger and soy, loaded into bowls with bok choy so there are more wontons than soup.
Long crisp rolls of cabbage, shiitake and glass noodles, sweet chilli to dip

Packed tight and built long like one of Holtzmann's proton wands, and only slightly less likely to go off in your hands. Soak 100g rice vermicelli and snip short. Stir-fry a quarter of a wombok, 2 grated carrots, 150g sliced shiitake and 4 spring onions until wilted, add 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil, toss with the noodles and cool. Roll a spoonful tightly in each of 20 wrappers and seal with cornflour paste. Fry at 180C until golden and serve with sweet chilli sauce.
Avocado, edamame and lime dip with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks
Avocado, edamame, lime, garlic and coriander blitzed bright green, served with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks.
M: Zhu's sweet and sour chicken with egg fried rice
Crispy chicken tossed with pineapple and peppers, egg fried rice on the side
The kind of takeaway the Hunan place downstairs sends up, if they ever get the order right. Crisp cornflour-coated chicken thigh tossed in a tangy pineapple and capsicum sauce, with egg fried rice.
Times Square onion sauce hot dogs
Kevin's floating hot dog, Times Square style

All-beef franks griddled until split, in soft buns with spicy brown mustard, sweet onions stewed in tomato and a little chilli, and pickle relish. Slice 2 onions thinly and cook in oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until soft. Add 3 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp sugar, half a tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp vinegar and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick and sticky. Griddle 8 all-beef franks until blistered and split. Warm 8 hot dog buns. Fill with franks, mustard, the onion sauce and a spoon of pickle relish.
W: Crisp vanilla cookies folded around paper fortunes
Thin batter of egg white, sugar, flour and vanilla baked at 180C in small rounds for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while still hot.
K: Kiwi, lime and mint puree over crushed ice, topped with soda water

Kiwifruit blitzed with lime juice, mint and sugar syrup, poured over crushed ice and topped with fizzy soda water so it foams up bright green. Dissolve 60g sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. Peel 4 kiwifruit and blitz with the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint leaves and the syrup until smooth. Spoon into four tall glasses over crushed ice. Top each slowly with 150ml cold soda water so it foams up, stir once and add a lime wheel.

s.note: Pork and prawn wontons in ginger chicken broth with bok choy
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, grated ginger and soy. Fill wonton wrappers and fold. Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with ginger slices and soy, add the wontons and cook 4 minutes. Add halved bok choy for the last minute and load up the bowls.

s.note: Long crisp rolls of cabbage, shiitake and glass noodles, sweet chilli to dip
s.how: Soak the vermicelli in hot water 5 minutes, drain and snip into short lengths. Stir-fry the wombok, carrot, mushrooms and sliced spring onion in a splash of the oil until wilted, then add the soy and sesame oil. Toss with the noodles and cool completely. Mix the cornflour with a little water. Roll a spoonful of filling tightly in each wrapper, folding in the sides, and seal with the paste. Heat the oil to 180°C and fry the rolls in batches until golden. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce.

s.note: Avocado, edamame and lime dip with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks
s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed edamame, the juice of 2 limes, a crushed garlic clove, a handful of coriander and salt until smooth and very green. Spoon into a bowl and serve with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks for dipping.

m.note: Crispy chicken tossed with pineapple and peppers, egg fried rice on the side
m.how: Cut the chicken into chunks and coat in cornflour. Fry in the oil in batches until crisp. Simmer rice vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce, add pineapple and sliced capsicum. Make egg fried rice from the cold rice. Toss the chicken through the sauce and serve with the rice.

w.note: Crisp vanilla cookies folded around paper fortunes
w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites with 80g sugar, then mix in 60g flour, 30g melted butter and a drop of vanilla. Spread thin rounds on a lined tray and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Working fast while hot, lay a paper fortune on each, fold in half and bend over a cup edge.
